title: Ruins Mechanism
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji reached into the light curtain, his fingertips touched not cold mechanism pivots but a warm, pulsating fragment like a living heart—the second page of the Tianji Record.

text.content:
The rumble tore through the ruins like heavenly silk splitting. Beneath Chen Ji's feet, intricate patterns blazed across the blue bricks, awakened bloodlines spreading in all directions.

"Bad—it's the guardian puppet's awakening formation!" Ye Qing barked, demonic energy exploding around her as a black barrier enveloped all three.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment in his mind racing through pages. He saw it—three breaths later, this ruins dormant for ten thousand years would fully awaken, with countless mechanism puppets breaking through the walls.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji! How much do you actually know?"

Su Qingyao's sword light swept across, slicing flying debris into dust. Her eyes flickered with complex emotions—these ruins held dangers far beyond expectations, yet this "waste" reacted with uncanny speed.

"Survive first, explain later." Chen Ji sidestepped a shooting formation rune, his voice calm as if not trapped in danger.

text.content:
RUMBLE—

Ahead, a stone gate a zhang tall burst open. A puppet wrapped in golden-bronze light stepped out slowly, each footfall shaking the ground. The formation disk embedded in its chest spun rapidly, emanating suffocating pressure.

"Upper-grade Xuan-level guardian puppet!" Ye Qing gasped, "The ruins' rank is even higher than I imagined!"

Hollow eye sockets in the puppet blazed with eerie light, locking onto the nearest target—Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji stood motionless, letting that spiritual sense scan his entire body. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly into a faint smile.

"It's locked onto me." He turned to the two women. "You have two choices—force through, outsmart it, or wait to die."

Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged glances—the former's eyes showed playful interest, the latter was filled with scrutiny.

choice.prompt:

choices.description: Break through with overwhelming force, Su Qingyao and Ye Qing combining absolute combat power to crush the guardian puppet. Highest risk but fastest results.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes large amount of Spiritual Energy
choices.visible_reward: Pass the trial quickly, but may alert more puppets
choices.risk_hint: If Spiritual Energy is insufficient, will fall into prolonged attrition battle

text.content:
Su Qingyao's sword intent soared, frigid sword qi carrying fierce killing intent directly targeting the puppet's vital point. Ye Qing struck simultaneously, demonic path mist coiling silk-like around the puppet's limbs.

Two completely different attacks coordinated seamlessly—ice sealing the puppet's joints, demonic energy corroding its core formation!

dialogue.content:
"Strike its left rib's formation eye!" Su Qingyao coldly shouted.

Without hesitation, Ye Qing slapped out, jet-black demonic Yuan precisely hitting the puppet's weakness.

CRACK—

The puppet's chest shattered, toppling to the ground.

choices.description: Chen Ji sees through the mechanism formation's operating patterns, using cleverness to overcome brute force. Lowest risk but requires precise judgment.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, the Tianji Record Fragment in his mind racing. He saw it—the puppet's driving core was directly in the center of its chest, and what maintained its operation was that intricate formation map beneath its feet.

"The formation eye is three chi directly below it, the bronze-colored one." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Ye Qing, demonic energy interfere with it for three breaths. Su Qingyao, sword qi cut the formation runes."

dialogue.content:
The two women acted immediately upon hearing.

As demonic energy surged, the puppet's movements visibly lagged by half a beat. In that fleeting moment, Su Qingyao's sword qi like silver snakes darting from caves precisely severed the formation rune pivot!

The puppet toppled, eerie light in its eyes extinguished.

How did you know?

Su Qingyao sheathed her sword, gaze complicated as she stared at Chen Ji. This waste's recent performance showed no hint of being a waste at all?

Chen Ji simply smiled faintly, offering no answer. The secret of the Tianji Record, he had no intention of letting anyone know.

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow center slightly stirred, a wisp of Tianji Record's aura悄然溢出。那是与傀儡同源的力量——都是上古预言体系的残留。

[The original text appears to have encoding issues. Based on context:]

"Chen Ji's brow center slightly stirred, a wisp of Tianji Record's aura quietly leaked out. That was a force from the same source as the puppet—both remnants of the ancient prophetic system."

Indeed, the puppet's movements suddenly halted. The eerie light in its eye sockets flickered violently, seemingly confused by some incomprehensible information.

dialogue.content:
"Go!"

Ye Qing reacted instantly, grabbing Chen Ji's wrist as the three rushed toward the corridor's depths during the puppet's moment of hesitation.

She glanced sideways at Chen Ji, her gaze gaining new depth. This man's trump cards ran deeper than she imagined.

result_nodes.memory_label: 夜清察觉到了陈机身上的异常气息

text.content:
The corridor stretched deep, torchlight devoured by some invisible force, leaving only occasional flickering formation runes providing faint illumination. The air hung heavy with ancient dust and an indescribable staleness.

Chen Ji suddenly stopped.

Ahead, the passage divided into three forks, each descending into impenetrable darkness. At their junction stood a stone tablet three zhang high, covered densely with ancient inscriptions.

dialogue.content:
Is this... a three-choice fate formation?

Ye Qing's voice was uncharacteristically grave. Demonic path classics had recorded similar mechanisms—each path led to a different destiny, and those who chose incorrectly would be forever lost in the folds of time.

"The left one," Chen Ji suddenly spoke, "is a dead end. Those who enter will be torn apart by spatial forces."

Su Qingyao and Ye Qing both looked at him simultaneously.

How do you know?

Su Qingyao's hand was already on her sword hilt, her gaze cold as frost. This waste had avoided her questions, yet knew the ruins' mechanisms like the back of his hand—the problems within this, she must clarify.

Chen Ji turned to face her gaze, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his mouth.

"Just a guess."

choice.prompt: The choice at the three-way fork lay before them. Chen Ji seemed to have already seen through its mysteries, but Su Qingyao clearly wouldn't believe easily—

text.content:
Chen Ji crouched down, fingertips brushing the residual formation rune traces on the ground.

"Look here—" He pointed to the left passage entrance, "The formation runes converge inward, meaning space will continuously compress. Within three breaths, whoever walks in will be crushed to paste."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing leaned in to observe, and indeed discovered faint compression traces in the formation runes, raising an eyebrow.

"You're quite observant." Her tone gained more genuine recognition. "What about the middle one?"

"The middle is the real path, but with a trial. And the right one..." He paused, "is a trap within a trap, also an opportunity within an opportunity."

text.content:
Chen Ji stood up, brushed dust from his hands, and without looking back walked toward the middle passage.

"Believe me, follow. Don't believe me, go back."

His tone was as indifferent as commenting on pleasant weather.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao gritted her teeth but ultimately followed.

She, a senior inner disciple, when had anyone commanded her like this? But reason told her this waste knew far more than he revealed.

Ye Qing merely smiled and shook her head, following closely behind.

text.content:
Chen Ji casually pointed toward the right passage.

"That way's quieter, let's go that way."

Ye Qing's gaze flickered, seemingly sensing something, but quickly恢复正常，率先踏入右边通道。苏青瑶犹豫了一下，也跟了上去。

[The original text appears to have encoding issues. Based on context:]

"Ye Qing's gaze flickered, seemingly sensing something, but quickly returned to normal, stepping into the right passage first. Su Qingyao hesitated briefly, then followed."

Yet the two women had barely taken three steps when Chen Ji flicked his fingers gently behind them. A barely visible spiritual energy silently entered the passage entrance, resealing the trap about to trigger.

All happened in a flash, neither woman noticed.

text.content:
The middle passage was far narrower than imagined, both walls carved with cryptic symbols. As the three progressed deeper, those symbols began slowly glowing, emitting eerie blue light.

Suddenly, a light curtain appeared ahead.

Rippling like water waves, within it was vaguely visible a figure seated cross-legged. That figure was entirely wrapped in golden chains, its aura weak yet carrying a heart-stopping pressure.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted.

The Tianji Record violently quivered at this moment, characters on the fragment spontaneously appearing—"Tianji Guardian·Remnant Soul·Under Seal."

He suppressed the turmoil in his heart, continuing forward with unchanged expression.

"There's a trial ahead," his voice calm as usual, "Prepare for battle."

text.content:
Before his words finished, the light curtain exploded!

That remnant soul figure instantly opened its eyes, two substantial gazes like swords stabbing toward the three. Immediately after, countless golden chains shot out from all directions, carrying the momentum to destroy everything!

"Guardian puppet!" Ye Qing roared, demonic energy condensing into a shield before her.

Su Qingyao's sword light surged, frigid sword qi interweaving with the demonic shield, barely blocking the first wave of attacks.

choice.prompt: The remnant soul guardian's attacks were fierce and bizarre, countless golden chains coiling like living things. The two women's defense line was being gradually broken down—

choices.description: All three attack simultaneously, using strongest attacks to shatter the remnant soul's core. Highest risk but may achieve instant victory.
choices.visible_cost: Three people's Spiritual Energy heavily consumed
choices.visible_reward: Quick resolution, shocking the remnant soul
choices.risk_hint: If attack is countered, will fall into greater crisis

text.content:
"Attack!"

Su Qingyao's sword intent soared, one slash creating an ice dragon lunging at the remnant soul. Ye Qing simultaneously struck, demonic path great palm seal crashing down.

Chen Ji secretly formed hand seals, a hidden spiritual energy mixing into the two women's attack—that was the Tianji Record's aura, specifically targeting such guardian mechanisms.

dialogue.content:
The remnant soul figure let out a mournful wail, the golden chains actually stopping the moment they touched that hidden spiritual energy!

"Heav... Heavenly Secrets... You are..." The remnant soul's voice was filled with disbelief.

The next instant, the two women's attacks crashed down, the remnant soul figure instantly shattering into countless motes of light.

text.content:
Chen Ji pressed down on both women's shoulders.

"Don't rush, watch its chains."

The two women forcibly suppressed their attacks, observing carefully. Indeed, though the golden chains were fierce, after each attack there was a momentary pause—the formation's operating gap.

dialogue.content:
"I see it!" Ye Qing's eyes brightened, "The moment it contracts next, strike the formation eye in its chest!"

Three breaths later, the golden chains indeed contracted again.

Su Qingyao thrust out her sword, precisely hitting the weakness. The remnant soul let out a wail, the formation instantly collapsing!

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment in his mind suddenly blazing with dazzling light. An invisible wave spread from his body, creating a strange resonance with the remnant soul's aura.

The golden chains suddenly stopped!

dialogue.content:
"Inheritor...?" The remnant soul's voice no longer carried mechanical hostility, but trembled slightly, "You... you are the Ancestral Master's..."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, voice calm.

"I've come to retrieve what belongs to the Tianji Record."

The remnant soul was silent for a moment, then slowly dispersed the golden chains, revealing an aged,虚弱的面容。

[The original text appears to have encoding issues. Based on context:]

"The remnant soul was silent for a moment, then slowly dispersed the golden chains, revealing an aged, weak face."

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现了远超废物设定的力量

text.content:
The remnant soul slowly drifted to the ground, golden chains completely dispersed. Its form was so ethereal as to be nearly transparent, clearly the seal had drained most of its strength.

"I've waited so long..." The remnant soul's voice was hoarse and weary, "The inheritor of the Tianji Record, has finally come."

Su Qingyao and Ye Qing simultaneously looked at Chen Ji, their gazes filled with shock. This waste, how many more secrets was he hiding?

dialogue.content:
Tianji Record? Who exactly are you?

Su Qingyao's voice was almost hissed through clenched teeth. From the moment of entry, this waste had been deceiving everyone. She stepped closer, sword qi condensing at her fingertips.

"Chen Ji, you better give me an explanation."

text.content:
Chen Ji ignored Su Qingyao's interrogation, instead looking at the remnant soul.

"Where is the mechanism core?"

The remnant soul pointed behind him at that slowly dissipating barrier. Deep within the barrier, an ancient stone platform stood quietly, and upon that platform, a soft light pulsed gently.

That light... shared the exact same aura as the Tianji Record.

The remnant soul seemed to sense Chen Ji's longing, a complex smile appearing on its aged face.

"Go... that's the second page... has waited for you so long..."

Before the words finished, the remnant soul completely dissipated, turning into motes of starlight merging into the stone platform. Its mission, finally complete.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, walking toward the stone platform. Behind him, Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged glances, both seeing the same question in each other's eyes—just how many secrets was this man still hiding?
